name: JPMorgan Global Core Real Assets Limited NPV (EUR)

announcements.headline: Result of EGM and Entry into Voluntary Liquidation
announcements.insight: The entry into voluntary liquidation signifies the winding up of the company, which typically results in the termination of shares and a final distribution to shareholders. This represents a fundamental corporate action with severe implications for the continued existence of the entity.

announcements.headline: Suspension of shares from trading on main market
announcements.insight: The suspension of shares from trading halts all liquidity for shareholders, preventing them from buying or selling their holdings until further notice. This action typically indicates a significant corporate event or regulatory issue requiring immediate market attention.

announcements.headline: PUBLICATION OF CIRCULAR
announcements.insight: JPMorgan Global Core Real Assets Limited NPV (EUR) publishes a circular following its June wind-down completion. Shareholders should review this document for details on the proposed voluntary liquidation.

announcements.headline: Managed Wind-Down Completion & Proposed Vol Liq'n
announcements.insight: Managed Wind-Down Completion & Proposed Vol Liq'n signals the end of operations. Shareholders should expect a voluntary liquidation process to distribute remaining assets.
